correctness.rationale: Circular BV integration by parts is exact. Zero derivative mass gives equal positive/negative Jordan masses; common-mass padding enables full half-difference moment body. The interval first/second moment constraints are necessary and sufficient, and the one-dimensional mean minimization gives sharp ceiling for every x. Convexity gives every interior point; scaling yields exact inverse gauge. Equality of upper and lower moment bounds identifies all pushforward supports and finite-jump realizations. Rational checker is supplemental; all-dimensional-in-n theorem is analytic.
